desc: DarkSwap is a privacy-focused swap interface for Solana-origin transactions. It currently provides two live manual-deposit routes: an existing private route powered by Houdini / HoudiniSwap and a Privacy Swap route built on the NEAR Intents 1Click API with confidential handling. Users can review a live quote and order details before manually sending funds from their own Solana wallet. DarkSwap does not require a wallet connection, does not sign or broadcast the user’s deposit transaction, and does not custody user funds. The project is also developing a cross-chain terminal on NEAR Intents and a separate Phase 2 product called the Dark Pool.
